newsitem.title: USA: Community Trust to issue preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Community Trust to issue preferred shares.

text.p: Community Trust Bancorp Inc said on Friday it intends to raise $30.0 million through the issuance of nine percent cumulative trust preferred securities.

Proceeds from the offering will be applied to the company's general funds to be used for expansion through new branches and acquisitions, to fund growth in the company's indirect consumer loan portfolio and for general corporate purposes, the company said.
The trust preferred securities will be issued at $25 per share and will be quoted on The Nasdaq Stock Market's National Market under the symbol CTBIP, Community Trust said.
Morgan Keegan & Co and J.J.B. Hilliard, W.L. Lyons Inc are the underwriters for the offering, Community Trust said.
